verses.text: Ayik 99 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Abram ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan icha tik: --Ha in ton Dios in, syal wuj masanil, wach'nhej tzutej a b'a t'a wichanh.
Ol wak' jun in trato het'ok, tzijtum inhtilal ol elok, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix em nhojan winhaj Abram chi' t'a sat lu'um yakb'an wan slolon Dios yet' winh. Ix yalan icha tik:
--Haton jun in trato tik ol wak' het'ok: Ol ach och smam yichamok tzijtumal nakión.
Manhxo ol a kuch Abram, palta Abraham xo ol a b'iej, yujto ol ach wak'och smam yichamok tzijtumal nakión.
Tzijtum ol aj wik'anchaanh sb'isul inhtilal, tzijtum nakión ol pitzwok yuj heb'. Ha t'a skal inhtilal chi', ay heb' rey ol elta.
Ha jun in trato swak' het'ok tik yet' masanil heb' inhtilal chi' to a Diosal in, sDiosal in pax heb' inhtilal chi' t'a junelnhej.
Ha tiknaik paxyalwum ach t'a lum Canaán tik, palta masanil lu'um tik ol wak' ikej yet' heb' inhtilal t'a junelnhej, sDiosal in pax heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Dios t'a winh: --Ha hachxo tik, k'anab'ajej jun in trato tik, yowalil sk'anab'ajej pax heb' inhtilal chi' ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Ha jun in trato wan in b'oan tik heyet'ok to yowalil tze k'anab'ajej. Masanil heb' winak unin, ochokab' yechel sniwanil heb'.
Yuj chi' ik'jokab'el stz'umal sjolom swinakil heb' he winak unin. Ha jun chi' yechel in trato yaj heyet'ok.

Yukub'ixial yaj junjun winak unin tz'och jun yechel chi' t'a heb', wach'chom eyuninal ma yuninal heb' he chekab'. Yowalil tz'ak'jipaxoch jun yechel chi' t'a heb' he chekab', heb' manb'il t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Yowalil tz'och jun yechel chi' t'ayex, max yal yek'b'ati. Icha chi' b'ian, a jun in trato tik heyet'ok niwan chekel ol aj t'a he niwanil t'a junelnhej.
Yalnhej mach junok winak to malaj jun yechel chi' t'ay, yowalil tzeyik'el t'a he kal, yujto max sk'anab'ajej in trato ix wak' heyet'ok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ayik ol b'eyb'at tiempo tik, manhxo Sarai-ok ol sb'iej ix etb'eyum, palta Sara ol sb'iej ix.

Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix, ol aljok junok uninal yet' ix. Wal yel ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh ix. Nunab'il ol aj ix t'a tzijtumal nakión. Tzijtum heb' winh sreyal chonhab' ol elta t'a skal yinhtilal ix chi', xchi.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Abraham chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um, ix och ijan winh stzewaji, ix och ijan winh snaub'tanhani: ¿Tom olto aljok wuninal? kien ab'ilxo in k 'inal, 90 ab'ilxo sk'inal ix Sara, ¿tom olto wal aljok yune' ix? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a Dios icha tik: --Tzin k'an t'ayach, tzok el wal t'a a k'ool tzak' sk'inal winhaj Ismael tik yik wach' ol elk'och winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Toxo ix wal t'ayach to ol aljok junok uninal yet' ix Sara. Isaac ol ak' sb'iej, haton yet' winh ol wak'elk'och jun in trato tik t'a masanil k 'inal yet' heb' yinhtilal winh.

Ha pax winhaj Ismael jun, toxo ix wab' tas ix ala', ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh winh, yuj chi' tzijtum ol aj yinhtilal winh. Ol q'uib'chaanh sb'isul yinhtilal winh. Ha t'a skal yinhtilal winh chi', ol elta lajchawanh heb' niwak yajal. Ha yinhtilal winh chi', niwak nakión ol ajok.
Palta a in trato ix wak' het'ok, ol wak'elk'och yet' winhaj Isaac winh uninal ol aljok t'a ix Sara t'a junxo ab'il icha tiempo tik, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon Dios yet' winh, ix paxk'ei.

Haton t'a jun k'u chi' ix schek winhaj Abraham ak'jioch jun yechel chi' t'a winhaj Ismael yet' t'a masanil heb' winh schekab' winh, heb' aljinak t'a yol skuenta winh yet' masanil heb' winh manb'il yuj winh yet' masanil heb' kajan yet' winh. Ix ak'jioch yechel heb' smasanil, icha ix aj yalan Dios t'a winh.
Ha winhaj Abraham chi', 99 ab'il sk'inal winh, haxo winhaj Ismael 13 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix ak'jioch jun yechel chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix ak'jioch jun yechel chi' t'a heb' winh schawanhil
yet' t'a masanil heb' winh ayek' yet' winhaj Abraham chi', heb' schekab' winh aljinak t'a yol skuenta yet' heb' manb'il yuj winh t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il.
